infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MedHelp uses the camera only to read a prescription label. The photo is read on this device and is never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MedHelp uses your photos only to read a prescription label you choose. The photo is read on this device and is never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MedHelp uses your location only to fill in your ZIP code and estimate how far away a provider is. Only the ZIP code is sent when searching the provider directory - your exact location never leaves this device.
